sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》，庆祝175年来致力于帮助您了解世界并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.

sentences.en: Welcome back.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回来。

sentences.en: We're getting breaking news into our newsroom this morning.
sentences.zh: 今天早上我们新闻编辑室收到了突发新闻。

sentences.en: The jury in Delaware has reached a verdict in the federal trial for President Joe Biden's son, Hunter Biden.
sentences.zh: 特拉华州的陪审团已对乔·拜登总统之子亨特·拜登的联邦审判作出裁决。

sentences.en: On count one, the verdict is guilty.
sentences.zh: 第一项指控，裁决为有罪。

sentences.en: On count two, the verdict is guilty.
sentences.zh: 第二项指控，裁决为有罪。

sentences.en: And on count three, the verdict is guilty.
sentences.zh: 第三项指控，裁决为有罪。

sentences.en: It is the first time in history that the child of a sitting president has been convicted of federal charges.
sentences.zh: 这是历史上首次有在任总统的子女被判联邦罪名成立。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: Today, why a jury found Hunter Biden guilty on federal gun charges.
sentences.zh: 今天，探讨为什么陪审团裁定亨特·拜登联邦枪支指控罪名成立。

sentences.en: What it will mean for his father.
sentences.zh: 这对他的父亲意味着什么。

sentences.en: And what it could do to the presidential race.
sentences.zh: 以及这可能对总统竞选产生什么影响。

sentences.en: White House reporter Katie Rogers is our gueSt.
sentences.zh: 白宫记者凯蒂·罗杰斯是我们的嘉宾。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, June 12th.
sentences.zh: 今天是6月12日，星期三。

sentences.en: Katie, I think we have to start by just recognizing the extraordinary and really improbable situation that we're in as of today, which is that over the past two weeks,
sentences.zh: 凯蒂，我想我们得先认识到我们今天所处的这种非同寻常且确实令人难以置信的局面，那就是在过去两周里，

sentences.en: the former president of the United States was found guilty of a crime.
sentences.zh: 美国前总统被判有罪。

sentences.en: And the son of the current president of the United States was found guilty of a crime.
sentences.zh: 而美国现任总统的儿子也被判有罪。

sentences.en: All during a presidential race between those two presidents.
sentences.zh: 这一切都发生在那两位总统之间的总统竞选期间。

sentences.en: It's just kind of staggering.
sentences.zh: 这简直令人震惊。

sentences.en: It's remarkable.
sentences.zh: 这太引人注目了。

sentences.en: I was in a hotel lobby next door to the courthouse yesterday after the jury went to deliberate
sentences.zh: 昨天陪审团去商议裁决时，我就在法院隔壁的酒店大堂里，

sentences.en: and happened to glance over at CNN and saw former President Trump walking to attend a probation appointment.
sentences.zh: 碰巧瞥了一眼CNN，看到前总统特朗普正走去参加缓刑面谈。

sentences.en: And just the starkness of that really hit home where we're in this moment where the former president has a probation officer and the president's son is on the precipice of being
sentences.zh: 那种鲜明的对比真的让人感触颇深，我们正处于这样一个时刻：前总统有缓刑监督官，而总统的儿子正处于

sentences.en: convicted of three felony gun charges.
sentences.zh: 被判三项重罪枪支指控的边缘。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And there was never any doubt that Trump's case was going to go to trial because he made very clear he was never going to accept a plea deal.
sentences.zh: 而且毫无疑问，特朗普的案件肯定会进入审判阶段，因为他明确表示绝不会接受认罪协议。

sentences.en: But I think for a lot of us, the Hunter Biden case has been a more confusing legal saga.
sentences.zh: 但我认为对我们许多人来说，亨特·拜登的案件是一场更令人困惑的法律传奇。

sentences.en: The last time we talked about it on this show, Hunter Biden was very deep in negotiations with the federal government to try to reach a plea deal that would avoid a trial.
sentences.zh: 上次我们在节目中谈论此事时，亨特·拜登正与联邦政府进行深入谈判，试图达成一项避免审判的认罪协议。

sentences.en: And then those negotiations collapse.
sentences.zh: 然后那些谈判破裂了。

sentences.en: So catch us up, Katie, on what happened next and how it is we got to this guilty set of verdicts.
sentences.zh: 所以，凯蒂，请为我们梳理一下接下来发生了什么，以及我们是如何走到这一系列有罪判决的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And it's been a real saga.
sentences.zh: 这确实是一场漫长的传奇。

sentences.en: You know, as a reminder, this stems back to the administration of President Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 你知道，提醒一下，这要追溯到唐纳德·特朗普总统的政府时期。

sentences.en: At the time, the president and other Republicans were itching to find ways to undercut the candidacy of Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 当时，总统和其他共和党人急于寻找削弱乔·拜登竞选资格的方法。

sentences.en: And one way to do that is to look into the business dealings and life of his troubled son, Hunter Biden.
sentences.zh: 而其中一种方法就是调查他那麻烦不断的儿子亨特·拜登的商业往来和生活。

sentences.en: So before Donald Trump leaves office, a federal prosecutor named David Weiss has been appointed
sentences.zh: 因此，在唐纳德·特朗普卸任前，一位名叫大卫·韦斯的联邦检察官被任命，

sentences.en: to look into Hunter Biden in a wide investigation that is centered around Hunter Biden's finances.
sentences.zh: 负责对亨特·拜登进行广泛调查，重点围绕亨特·拜登的财务状况。

sentences.en: So flash forward to almost a year ago exactly.
sentences.zh: 时间快进到几乎一年前的今天。

sentences.en: Hunter Biden and his legal team have reached a deal with Weiss on tax charges and also this gun charge that would avoid jail time and basically avoid the outcome we just saw today.
sentences.zh: 亨特·拜登及其法律团队已与韦斯就税务指控以及这项枪支指控达成协议，这将避免牢狱之灾，基本上可以避免我们今天看到的这种结果。

sentences.en: But when that plea deal gets in front of a judge, it becomes clear that both sides are not in
sentences.zh: 但当该认罪协议提交给法官时，很明显双方并没有

sentences.en: agreement about what this deal means, particularly around the issue of whether or not Hunter
sentences.zh: 就该协议的含义达成一致，特别是在亨特是否

sentences.en: Biden should face future charges.
sentences.zh: 应该面临未来指控的问题上。

sentences.en: The judge sends them back to negotiate, but Hunter Biden's team opts not to do that.
sentences.zh: 法官让他们回去重新谈判，但亨特·拜登的团队选择不这样做。

sentences.en: They decide to roll the dice, essentially challenges Weiss to take this thing to trial.
sentences.zh: 他们决定孤注一掷，本质上是挑战韦斯将此案诉诸审判。

sentences.en: Weiss takes them up on it, brings the charges, and that led to the trial that we saw play out in Delaware last week.
sentences.zh: 韦斯接受了挑战，提起了指控，这导致了我们上周在特拉华州看到的审判。

sentences.en: And that trial ends up being pretty narrowly focused on gun charges.
sentences.zh: 而那场审判最终非常狭隘地集中在枪支指控上。

sentences.en: Just remind us what exactly those charges are.
sentences.zh: 请提醒我们这些指控到底是什么。

sentences.en: So basically what got Hunter Biden in trouble is that during October 2018, he goes to a gun store in Wilmington, Delaware, looking to buy a revolver.
sentences.zh: 基本上，导致亨特·拜登陷入麻烦的是，2018年10月，他去特拉华州威尔明顿的一家枪店，想要购买一把左轮手枪。

sentences.en: And he filled out a form that said at that current time, he was not an unlawful user of drugs and was not addicted to drugs.
sentences.zh: 他填写了一份表格，声明在当时，他不是非法药物使用者，也没有药物成瘾。

sentences.en: And that is one of the disqualifiers that gun sellers use to disqualify people from purchasing a firearm.
sentences.zh: 而这是枪支销售商用来取消人们购买枪支资格的条件之一。

sentences.en: So basically prosecutors are saying that at that time, Hunter Biden lied to the gun dealer on that form, lied on the form itself, and illegally possessed a handgun.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上检察官是在说，当时亨特·拜登在表格上对枪支经销商撒了谎，在表格本身上撒了谎，并非法持有了一把手枪。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: They're saying he was, in fact, a drug user at that time.
sentences.zh: 他们是说他当时确实是一名药物使用者。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So take us into the trial itself.
sentences.zh: 那么带我们了解一下审判本身吧。

sentences.en: How do federal prosecutors go about making their case that Hunter Biden lied when he signed that form?
sentences.zh: 联邦检察官是如何证明亨特·拜登在签署该表格时撒了谎的？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So essentially, prosecutors have to prove that Hunter Biden was addicted and an unlawful user of drugs during this period in October where he possessed a handgun.
sentences.zh: 本质上，检察官必须证明亨特·拜登在10月份持有手枪的这段时期内，确实有药物成瘾且是非法药物使用者。

sentences.en: But throughout the trial, which was interesting, and the judge agreed that this was the case, they repeatedly
sentences.zh: 但在整个审判过程中，有趣的是，法官也同意这一点，他们反复

sentences.en: said, we do not have to prove that he was using on the day he purchased the gun or even during the time he had the gun.
sentences.zh: 表示，我们不需要证明他在购买枪支的那天，甚至在他持有枪支的那段时间里正在使用药物。

sentences.en: So in that sense, prosecutors have a really wide window of opportunity to essentially prove that Hunter Biden was a drug addict around this time.
sentences.zh: 所以从这个意义上说，检察官有非常宽泛的机会窗口来证明亨特·拜登在这一时期确实有药物成瘾。

sentences.en: So prosecutors have a lot to work with.
sentences.zh: 所以检察官有很多证据可以使用。

sentences.en: They have documents, including text messages, bank receipts, ATM withdrawals to present to the jury.
sentences.zh: 他们有文件，包括短信、银行收据、ATM取款记录，可以呈交给陪审团。

sentences.en: But they also have a 2021 memoir written by Hunter
sentences.zh: 但他们还有亨特·拜登在2021年写的回忆录，

sentences.en: Biden that extensively detailed his drug addiction, the depths of it.
sentences.zh: 书中详尽地描述了他的药物成瘾，以及成瘾的深度。

sentences.en: And it certainly involves a time during which he purchased this gun.
sentences.zh: 这当然涉及他购买这把枪的时间段。

sentences.en: He doesn't talk about it in the book, but there are passages in it in which he recounts buying drugs in Wilmington, the addiction he fell into with other family members.
sentences.zh: 他在书中没有提到这件事，但书中确实有段落讲述了他在威尔明顿购买毒品，以及他与其他家庭成员一起陷入的成瘾状态。

sentences.en: And snippets of that memoir, which were read in Hunter Biden's voice, were piped in by prosecutors into that courtroom.
sentences.zh: 而那本回忆录的片段，由亨特·拜登的声音朗读出来，被检察官播放到了法庭里。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So the prosecution starts with a pretty serious mountain of problematic evidence, it would sound like
sentences.zh: 所以控方一开始就掌握了一座相当严重的、成问题的证据大山，听起来

sentences.en: for Hunter Biden, including his own words documenting drug use during the period that's at the center of this trial.
sentences.zh: 对亨特·拜登很不利，包括他自己记录了审判核心时期药物使用的文字。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And on top of all this, on top of all of that evidence, they have witnesses who were very close to
sentences.zh: 而且最重要的是，在所有这些证据之上，他们还有与亨特非常亲近的证人，

sentences.en: Hunter who detailed his drug use and the toll it took on them at some points, including his ex-wife
sentences.zh: 他们详细描述了他的药物使用以及在某些时刻对他造成的伤害，包括他的前妻

sentences.en: Kathleen Buell, who was married to him for 24 years and recounted on the stand periods in which she
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳·布尔，她与他结婚24年，并在证人席上讲述了她努力让他去戒毒的时期，

sentences.en: struggled to get him into rehab, during which their marriage essentially fell apart because he was so deep into drug use and also infidelity.
sentences.zh: 期间他们的婚姻基本上破裂了，因为他深陷毒瘾，还有不忠行为。

sentences.en: And then probably most powerfully, they called Hallie Biden, who is the widow of Hunter Biden's older brother, Beau Biden.
sentences.zh: 然后，可能最有力的证人是哈莉·拜登，她是亨特·拜登已故哥哥博·拜登的遗孀。

sentences.en: Beau died in 2015.
sentences.zh: 博于2015年去世。

sentences.en: And after that, Hunter Biden and Hallie
sentences.zh: 在那之后，亨特·拜登和哈莉·拜登陷入了浪漫关系，

sentences.en: Biden fall into a romantic relationship during which she testified that she fell into crack cocaine use with him.
sentences.zh: 她作证说她和亨特一起陷入了快克可卡因的使用中。

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So Hallie testifies that not only was she aware of Hunter Biden's drug use, but she actually descends into drug addiction with him.
sentences.zh: 所以哈莉作证说，她不仅知道亨特·拜登的药物使用，而且实际上和他一起陷入了毒瘾。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So what really came through during Hallie Biden's testimony was the hell she sort of described that she was in with Hunter Biden as they fell into drug addiction.
sentences.zh: 所以在哈莉·拜登的证词中，真正传达出来的是她描述的与亨特·拜登一起陷入毒瘾时的那种地狱般的生活。

sentences.en: She had said they were buying ping pong size balls, of crack cocaine, and using them together.
sentences.zh: 她说他们当时购买乒乓球大小的快克可卡因，并一起使用。

sentences.en: And Hunter would disappear for days at a time, telling her that he was, you know, quote, sleeping on a car and smoking crack.
sentences.zh: 亨特会一连消失好几天，告诉她他，你知道，引用他的话说，是在车里睡觉和抽快克。

sentences.en: And eventually, you know, she begins trying to
sentences.zh: 最终，你知道，她开始尝试清理他车里的吸毒用具。

sentences.en: clean out his car of drug paraphernalia.
sentences.zh: 她偶然发现了亨特·拜登车里保险箱里的这把手枪。

sentences.en: She stumbles upon this handgun that is in a lockbox in Hunter Biden's car.
sentences.zh: 正如她作证时所说，也正如检察官在法庭上展示的那样，哈莉·拜登当时给亨特·拜登发短信说，我惊慌失措。

sentences.en: And as she testified and as prosecutors displayed in court, Hallie Biden was texting Hunter
sentences.zh: 我把它扔掉了。

sentences.en: Biden at that time saying, I panicked.
sentences.zh: 他因为她这样做而责备她。

sentences.en: I just threw it away.
sentences.zh: 这真的重现了两个深陷毒瘾的人之间那段充满戏剧性、非常混乱的时期。

sentences.en: He's admonishing her for doing that.
sentences.zh: 而这一切都发生在检察官最关注的时间段周围。

sentences.en: And it just really recounts this high drama, very messy period of time between two people who are in the throes of addiction.
sentences.zh: 凯蒂，当所有这些证词被陈述，这些非常令人尴尬和痛苦的细节被曝光时，法庭里的气氛是怎样的？

sentences.en: And it is all around the time that prosecutors are most focused on.
sentences.zh: 法庭里的气氛和大多数审判一样，沉重而严肃。

sentences.en: Katie, as all of this testimony is being given and these really pretty embarrassing and painful details are being aired, what is the mood like in that courtroom?
sentences.zh: 但它也显得超现实，因为在这个为期一周的审判的大部分时间里，第一夫人吉尔·拜登就坐在亨特·拜登身后的第一排。

sentences.en: So the mood in the courtroom was somber and serious as most trials are.
sentences.zh: 所以美国第一夫人一直注视着亨特、检察官和辩护团队。

sentences.en: But it was also surreal because for most days of this week-long trial, Jill Biden, the first lady, was in the front row sitting directly behind Hunter Biden.
sentences.zh: 大多数审判期间她都在场，她只离开了一天去法国，然后又从法国离开总统身边回到这个审判现场。

sentences.en: So the first lady of the United States keeps her eyes on Hunter, on the prosecutors, on the defense team.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这是拜登家族优先事项最鲜明的写照。

sentences.en: Most of the trials, she left for one day to go to
sentences.zh: 昨天在法庭上，我数了一下，至少有八名拜登家族成员在场。

sentences.en: France and she left the president's side in France to come back to this trial.
sentences.zh: 亨特的叔叔吉米·拜登坐在第一排，他的妹妹阿什莉·拜登也在。

sentences.en: That is the starkest illustration to me of the Biden family's priorities.
sentences.zh: 他的姑姑瓦莱丽·拜登-欧文斯，在他母亲去世后抚养了他最初几年，也坐在第一排。

sentences.en: At one point yesterday in the courtroom, I counted at least eight members of the Biden family.
sentences.zh: 这已经变成了一种家庭事务。

sentences.en: Hunter's uncle, Jimmy Biden, was sitting in the front row, as was his sister, Ashley Biden.
sentences.zh: 坐在法庭里看着拜登一家看着受审的亨特·拜登，这鲜明地提醒人们，虽然亨特·拜登成瘾的一些细节有时令人震惊地公开，但最亲近他的人所面临的痛苦在很大程度上一直是个人的。

sentences.en: His aunt, Valerie Biden-Owens, who raised him in the first years of his life after his mother died, was in the front row.
sentences.zh: 看到像哈莉·拜登这样的人走上证人席，详细描述药物使用并讲述她所经历的地狱，看到凯瑟琳·布尔走上证人席，谈论她试图让他戒毒却无法做到的时候，这确实提醒人们，

sentences.en: It had become sort of a family affair.
sentences.zh: 这个庞大且非常公开的家庭多年来一直在私下里试图逃避这一切，试图从中走出来。

sentences.en: Sitting in that courtroom watching the Bidens watch Hunter Biden on trial was a stark reminder that while
sentences.zh: 这确实让人感觉这个第一家庭最糟糕的私人痛苦时刻现在正被展示出来供公众消费。

sentences.en: some of the details of Hunter Biden's addiction have been startlingly public at times, the pain faced by the people closest to him has largely been private.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: And seeing people like Hallie Biden take the stand and detail drug use and recount this hell she had gone through, seeing Kathleen Buell take the
sentences.zh: 我是温娜·刘。

sentences.en: stand and talk about the times she tried to get him sober and couldn't do it, was a real reminder that
sentences.zh: 我编写《Connections》游戏，这是《纽约时报》游戏中的拼图之一。

sentences.en: this large, very public-facing family had privately for years been trying to outrun this, trying to move on from it.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。
